_what_this_is: Every quoted passage on the page, with either the source's own wording to match against, or a declaration that the marks are the page's own voice and why. A quotation nobody has checked against the source is not a quotation.
_rebuilt: 2026-09-01. The previous file held fourteen entries, four of which were not quotations at all: the extractor paired straight quotation marks left to right with a 25-character floor in the pattern, so a short quoted phrase ('is it better?', fourteen characters) was skipped and its closing mark paired with the next opening one. Everything after ran inverted. One of the four put a phrase in a press release's mouth that the page never attributed to it. extract() now pairs the marks first and applies the floor second.

quotations.quote: Intismeran autogene plus pembrolizumab improves recurrence-free survival versus pembrolizumab alone in resected stage IIB–IV melanoma.
quotations.why: The claim this page scores, formulated by us. It sits in the scoring block as the proposition under assessment, not as anything anyone said. No document is being quoted.

quotations.quote: absolute recurrence risk in that group is lower, so the same hazard ratio delivers a smaller absolute benefit.
quotations.verbatim: The Phase 2b population was stage IIIB-IV; the Phase 3 adds stage IIB and IIC - node-negative disease . Absolute recurrence risk in that group is lower, so the same hazard ratio delivers a smaller absolute benefit.
quotations.why: Morning Glory Sciences' argument that the Phase 3's added population changes what the hazard ratio delivers. Acquired and entered as S009 on 2026-09-01, split out of S006, which had carried this outlet in also_urls while holding a different outlet's article.

quotations.quote: can face risks of recurrence and melanoma-specific mortality similar to those observed in stage III disease.
quotations.verbatim: Notably, patients with resected stage IIB or IIC melanoma can face risks of recurrence and melanoma-specific mortality similar to those observed in stage III disease.
quotations.why: Pharmacy Times' counter-argument about the population the Phase 3 adds. Held since 2026-09-02: the operator saved the page from his browser after pharmacytimes.com returned 403 to every automated route. The wording had been confirmed twice before it was held -- by the fact-check gate on 2026-08-28 (verdict c38, found_value) and by a WebFetch on 2026-09-01 -- and it is now matched against the bytes themselves, which is the only one of the three that this system treats as an attestation.

quotations.quote: will be presented at an upcoming international medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities.
quotations.verbatim: These data will be presented at an upcoming international medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities.
quotations.why: The companies' own statement about when the Phase 3 data will appear. Read off S001, whose full text is held.

quotations.quote: statistically significant and clinically meaningful
quotations.verbatim: First and only combination regimen to demonstrate statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in RFS and DMFS compared to KEYTRUDA alone for these patients in the adjuvant melanoma setting
quotations.why: The only characterisation the release gives of the Phase 3 result. The page previously closed the quotation with a full stop inside the marks; S001 does not end a sentence there, so the stop was ours and now sits outside them.

quotations.quote: a 49% reduction in the hazard of recurrence or death
quotations.why: The page's own restatement of HR 0.510 as a percentage, and the sentence containing it says so: 'a correct restatement of the ratio'. NOTE FOR THE EDITOR: S001 carries the near-identical 'a 49% reduction in the risk of recurrence or death', and this page deliberately writes hazard where the release writes risk. A reader could take these marks as attribution. Removing them would end the ambiguity.

quotations.quote: is it different, in either direction?
quotations.why: The page explaining what a two-sided test asks. Its own words, in the voice of the test.

quotations.quote: as assessed by the investigator
quotations.verbatim: The primary endpoint is RFS, defined as the time from randomization to any disease recurrence (local, locoregional, regional or distant) as assessed by the investigator, or death due to any cause.
quotations.why: How the release defines the Phase 3 primary endpoint, which is the point the paragraph turns on: clinical judgement rather than central adjudication. Read off S001, whose full text is held.

quotations.quote: this treatment does nothing
quotations.why: The null hypothesis, named in plain words so a reader can see what an interval crossing 1.0 leaves open. Nobody said it.

quotations.quote: These subsequent analyses are not intended for formal hypothesis testing (ie, are descriptive only)
quotations.verbatim: These subsequent analyses are not intended for formal hypothesis testing (ie, are descriptive only). The statistical analysis plan prespecified estimation of HRs and 95% CIs using stratified Cox proportional hazards models
quotations.why: The three-year paper's own statement of what its analyses are, added on 2026-09-01 when the source advocate objected that 'cleared the line' implies a formal test the paper says it did not run. Read off S007, held in full.

quotations.quote: designed with approximately 80% power to detect a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.5
quotations.verbatim: The trial was designed with approximately 80% power to detect a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.5 with a one-sided a of 0.10 after 40 RFS events.
quotations.why:
The trial's own prespecified threshold, which decides whether 0.0266 and 0.053 are a win and a near miss or the same result well inside a registered line. Read off S007, held in full.

THE QUOTATION STOPS BEFORE THE ALPHA ON PURPOSE. The paper prints a Greek alpha and the PDF extracts it as the letter 'a', so a page quotation containing the character can never match the bytes we hold. The threshold is stated outside the quotation marks and carried verbatim by Q-12, from a second document that spells it out. Same shape as The Lancet's middle dot: a character, not a fact, deciding whether a check can see something.

quotations.quote: 1-sided alpha of 0.1 per protocol
quotations.verbatim: Designed with 80% power to detect a hazard ratio of 0.5 with 40 RFS events (with a 1-sided alpha of 0.1 per protocol)
quotations.why: The same threshold, stated independently in the ASCO 2024 presentation. Two held documents agree, which is why the sentence does not rest on one reading.

quotations.quote: 7 of 107 patients (6.5%) in the intismeran plus pembrolizumab arm and 7 of 50 (14.0%) in the pembrolizumab arm died
quotations.verbatim: Overall, 7 of 107 patients (6.5%) in the intismeran plus pembrolizumab arm and 7 of 50 (14.0%) in the pembrolizumab arm died (Fig 1C; Data Supplement, Table S1); the OS HR (95% CI) was 0.471 (0.165 to 1.345).
quotations.why: What 'n=14' is fourteen OF. The label is the press release's (S002 prints 'n=14' literally) and it does not say; the paper does, explicitly, arm by arm. Quoted on the page so a reader is not asked to take the split on our word.

quotations.quote: Because the Phase 3 hazard ratios have not been disclosed, those 157-patient figures cannot be placed alongside the 1,137-patient result. They belong to the Phase 2b population, not to this one.
quotations.verbatim: Because the Phase 3 hazard ratios have not been disclosed, those 157-patient figures cannot be placed alongside the 1,137-patient result . They belong to the Phase 2b population, not to this one.
quotations.why: The half of Morning Glory's argument the page had left out, and the one that decides what the section is about: the disagreement between the two outlets cannot be settled from anything published, because the Phase 3 has released no effect size.

quotations.quote: At 5 years, the recurrence-free survival rate was 68.8% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 56.3%-78.3%) in the combination arm and 49.1% (95% CI = 33.3%-63.0%) in the monotherapy arm
quotations.verbatim: At 5 years, the recurrence-free survival rate was 68.8% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 56.3%-78.3%) in the combination arm and 49.1% (95% CI = 33.3%-63.0%) in the monotherapy arm.
quotations.why: The five-year recurrence-free rates, reported from the analysis. Held since 2026-09-02. This is the document that shows 68.8% was never invented — it was removed from this page on 1 September as a figure in no held document, which was true of what we then held and not true of the literature.

quotations.quote: 5-year rates of 92.2% (95% CI = 84.2%-96.3%) in the combination arm and 71.3% (95% CI = 35.4%-89.6%) in the pembrolizumab alone arm
quotations.verbatim: There was a trend for improved overall survival as well, an exploratory endpoint (HR = 0.47; 95% CI = 0.17-1.35) with 5-year rates of 92.2% (95% CI = 84.2%-96.3%) in the combination arm and 71.3% (95% CI = 35.4%-89.6%) in the pembrolizumab alone arm.
quotations.why: The five-year survival rates, with the wide interval that is the point of the paragraph. Same document, same reason as Q-15.

quotations.quote: Seven patients died during follow-up in each arm
quotations.verbatim: Seven patients died during follow-up in each arm.
quotations.why: The per-arm split of the fourteen deaths, stated in plain words. The gate could not verify 7-and-7 from anything it reached; this document says it outright, and the JCO paper says it as 7 of 107 and 7 of 50.

quotations.quote: The companies have not disclosed hazard ratios, confidence intervals, p-values, median follow-up or event counts for the Phase 3 trial.
quotations.verbatim: The companies have not disclosed hazard ratios, confidence intervals, p-values, median follow-up or event counts for the Phase 3 trial.
quotations.why: MLQ News' enumeration of what the announcement withheld. The page gate reported this attribution as CONTRADICTED because no MLQ News article appeared in its search results. We hold the article; it reads exactly as the page said. Quoted now so the next run can see it too.

quotations.quote: The companies did not disclose hazard ratios, absolute event rates, P values, or other phase 3 efficacy estimates in the topline announcement.
quotations.verbatim: The companies did not disclose hazard ratios, absolute event rates, P values, or other phase 3 efficacy estimates in the topline announcement.
quotations.why: Practical Dermatology's own enumeration, which the gate rightly said we had understated by paraphrasing it.

quotations.quote: Detailed phase 3 efficacy metrics (e.g., HRs) were not disclosed; OS and other secondary endpoints remain immature
quotations.verbatim: Detailed phase 3 efficacy metrics (e.g., HRs) were not disclosed; OS and other secondary endpoints remain immature, while safety was consistent with prior combination experience.
quotations.why: Dermatology Times, acquired 2026-09-02 so that what this page says about it can be checked against it. The page's quotation originally closed with a full stop the source does not have there — its sentence continues 'while safety was consistent…'. Caught by comparing the transcription to the bytes, which this check had never done.

quotations.quote: purely qualitative assertion with no numeric support
quotations.why: Our own rubric's anchor for a data-support score of 1, quoted from backend/scripts/signal/score_claims.py, which is the file that defines the six dimensions and their anchors and is published in full at /the-rubric. Not a document anyone else wrote, so there is no external source to match it against; a reader checks it against the rubric page.

quotations.quote: No alpha was assigned to this analysis
quotations.verbatim: Exploratory endpoints included OS. No alpha was assigned to this analysis.
quotations.why: From the ASCO 2026 abstract, obtained by hand on 3 September after every automated fetch returned 403. It is the plainest support available for the page's point that the later KEYNOTE-942 analyses were descriptive rather than formal tests, which until now rested on the three-year paper's wording alone.

quotations.quote: These data will be presented at an upcoming international medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities.
quotations.verbatim: These data will be presented at an upcoming international medical meeting and shared with regulatory authorities.
quotations.why: The Phase 3 release's own statement of what happens next. Quoted in full from where its sentence begins, after the page gate reported on 3 September that starting at 'will be presented' clipped the subject and left the quotation less exact than it could be.
